summary: log-taker uses child_process to invoke bash/zsh
details: index.js imports child_process and invokes execSync with bash and zsh shells. Without traced corroboration, intent cannot be confirmed; the pattern alone does not establish exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, or other concrete installer-harm mechanism. The package name ("log-taker") together with shell execution warrants human review to determine whether the shell invocations process attacker-controlled input or read installer secrets.
